title: Playlet Snapshotter and Adaptive Runbook Balancer
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight Playlet Snapshotter service that captures a deterministic snapshot and compact diff of a runbook-as-task execution state, and an Adaptive Runbook Balancer that recommends and automatically shifts low-risk repair playlets to lower tiers (batch/ephemeral) while preserving safety SLOs. This ticket wires snapshot+diff artifacts into admin utilities so support automation can replay, compare, and gradually shift runbooks between execution modes for cost/latency optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshotter produces a compact JSON snapshot (<= 10KB typical) representing runbook inputs, KV cache references, decision branches taken, and final artifacts for a completed playlet
Diff view shows deterministic per-step changes between two snapshots and highlights non-idempotent steps
Balancer can tag a playlet as ELIGIBLE/INELIGIBLE for tiered execution based on safety policy and recent telemetry
Console shows per-playlet history, last snapshot timestamp, and a one-click replay button that runs in a sandboxed dry-run mode
End-to-end integration tests covering replay, diff, and balancer tagging (CI green)
